scenes.narration: Three signs your self-respect is growing. The last might feel like guilt.
One: You stop overexplaining. Saying 'I can't today' can be enough.
Two: You protect time for your goals, instead of treating everyone else's plans as more important.
Comment RESPECT for my free five-day self-respect challenge.
Three: You set a reasonable boundary, even when guilt appears. That discomfort doesn't necessarily mean you're wrong. Sometimes, you're simply practicing self-respect.
